user.title: Connect to UniFi Play
user.description: Choose how to find your UniFi Play devices. Direct connection talks to the speakers themselves and works on any network — including consoles that have no Apollo application (UCG-Fiber, Cloud Key, and others).

console.title: Connect via UniFi OS Console
console.description: Enter your UDM Pro (or UniFi OS Console) IP address or hostname (without https://) and an API key.

direct.title: Direct connection
direct.description: Home Assistant will find Play devices on its own subnet automatically. If your speakers are on a different VLAN or subnet, list their IP addresses here (comma separated) — you can read them from the UniFi Network client list or the Play mobile app.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the console. Check the IP or hostname is correct and reachable from Home Assistant, and that you entered it without https://. Enable debug logging for this integration (Settings → Devices & services → UniFi Play → ⋮ → Enable debug logging) and retry to capture more information.
error.invalid_auth: The console rejected the API key (HTTP 401). The Apollo application is installed, so this is purely a credential problem — create a new key under Settings → Control Plane → API Keys on this console and paste it whole.
error.forbidden: The console refused the API key (HTTP 403). API keys are per-console, so check the key was created on the console you entered and has not been revoked.
error.apollo_unavailable: This console has no Apollo application, which is what serves the UniFi Play API. Apollo installs itself when a console discovers UniFi Play hardware, but only where the package has been released for that console's model — on some models it never arrives. Go back and choose Direct connection instead: it does not need the console at all.
error.unsupported_api: The Apollo application answered but has no device API at the expected path. Your Apollo version may be newer or older than this integration supports — please open an issue including your console firmware and Apollo version.
error.cloud_host: That address is Ubiquiti's cloud (ui.com), which serves the Site Manager API — a different API that does not proxy Apollo, so this integration cannot use it. Enter your console's own IP address or local hostname instead, with an API key created on that console (Settings → Control Plane → API Keys).
error.no_devices_found: No UniFi Play devices answered on Home Assistant's subnet. If your speakers are on a different VLAN or subnet, enter their IP addresses in the field above. Otherwise check they are powered on and reachable from Home Assistant.
error.no_response: The addresses you entered answered neither the discovery probe (UDP 10001) nor an MQTT connection (TCP 8883). Check each IP is correct and that no firewall rule blocks those ports between Home Assistant and the speakers.
error.discovery_failed: Could not open a discovery socket. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

play_announcement.name: Play announcement
play_announcement.description: Play a prerecorded announcement clip immediately. The clip must already be on the speaker — upload it in the UniFi Play app first. Whatever is streaming is paused for the duration.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The UniFi Play speaker to act on.

filename.name: File name
filename.description: Name of a clip already stored on the speaker. Read it from the Announcements sensor's files attribute rather than from the UniFi Play app — the app's label is not the filename (a clip shown as "17" is really "New Recording 17.m4a"), and a wrong name fails silently.

length.name: Length
length.description: Clip duration in seconds. Leave empty to use the duration the speaker reported for this clip.

zone_play.name: Play across zone
zone_play.description: Play on every speaker in the zone rather than just this one.

stop_announcement.name: Stop announcement
stop_announcement.description: Stop an announcement that is currently playing and resume whatever was interrupted.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The UniFi Play speaker to act on.

delete_announcement_file.name: Delete announcement clip
delete_announcement_file.description: Remove a prerecorded announcement clip from the speaker. Clips can only be added from the UniFi Play app.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The UniFi Play speaker to act on.

filename.name: File name
filename.description: Name of a clip already stored on the speaker. Read it from the Announcements sensor's files attribute rather than from the UniFi Play app — the app's label is not the filename (a clip shown as "17" is really "New Recording 17.m4a"), and a wrong name fails silently.

set_alarm.name: Create or update alarm
set_alarm.description: Create an alarm on the speaker, or update an existing one by passing its ID. Alarms are scheduled and fired by the speaker itself, so they work whether or not Home Assistant is running.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The UniFi Play speaker to act on.

alarm_id.name: Alarm ID
alarm_id.description: ID of an existing alarm to update. Leave empty to create a new one.

name.name: Name
name.description: Label shown for the alarm in the UniFi Play app.

sound.name: Sound
sound.description: Alarm sound. One of Lunar Chimes, Cosmic Bounce, Digital Ripple, Island Breeze or Jungle Rhythm.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the alarm sounds, in minutes.

repeat.name: Repeat on
repeat.description: Weekdays the alarm repeats, 0 = Sunday through 6 = Saturday. Leave empty for a one-shot alarm.

delete_alarm.name: Delete alarm
delete_alarm.description: Delete an alarm from the speaker by its ID.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The UniFi Play speaker to act on.

alarm_id.name: Alarm ID
alarm_id.description: ID of the alarm to delete, as listed by the Alarms sensor.

set_quiet_hours.name: Create or update quiet hours
set_quiet_hours.description: Create a quiet-hours window on the speaker, or update an existing one by passing its ID. During the window the speaker limits or silences playback.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The UniFi Play speaker to act on.

quiet_id.name: Quiet hours ID
quiet_id.description: ID of an existing window to update. Leave empty to create a new one.

repeat.name: Repeat on
repeat.description: Weekdays the window applies, 0 = Sunday through 6 = Saturday. Leave empty to apply once.

wind_down.name: Wind down
wind_down.description: Minutes spent fading into the window rather than starting abruptly.

delete_quiet_hours.name: Delete quiet hours
delete_quiet_hours.description: Delete a quiet-hours window from the speaker by its ID.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The UniFi Play speaker to act on.

quiet_id.name: Quiet hours ID
quiet_id.description: ID of the window to delete, as listed by the Quiet Hours sensor.

save_eq_preset.name: Save EQ preset
save_eq_preset.description: Save the speaker's current 10-band equalizer settings as a named preset. The preset then appears in the EQ Preset selector.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The UniFi Play speaker to act on.

name.name: Preset name
name.description: Name to save the current EQ table under.

delete_eq_preset.name: Delete EQ preset
delete_eq_preset.description: Delete a saved custom EQ preset from the speaker.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The UniFi Play speaker to act on.

name.name: Preset name
name.description: Name of the preset to delete.

rename_eq_preset.name: Rename EQ preset
rename_eq_preset.description: Rename a saved custom EQ preset.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The UniFi Play speaker to act on.
